items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: I wanted to ask you about one thing that I read in a book by Bill Crow.

ctx.x: In the 80’s. Yeah, we did something at the shrine, when Mrs. Miller was there, in the audience. And Ben Pollack was there. Billy May was conducting the orchestra. That’s when he had Micky McMickle was on that, and I think Ray Anthony too, and there was another trumpet guy.
I wanted to ask you about one thing that I read in a book by Bill Crow. It has jazz stories in it. And it said something about you guys were at a Holiday Inn somewhere and it had a
sign, Happy Hour All You Can Drink for a Dollar. Do you remember this thing? Do you remember what you said?
